status: external inputs for the ground's rock (the globe's true colour); fetched and hash-checked by fetch_surface_inputs.py; ignored by Git

files.name: LROC_GLOBAL_MARE_180.ZIP
files.credit: Global Mapping of Lunar Mare Boundaries (65N and 65S), LROC RDR extras, PDS data set LRO-L-LROC-5-RDR-V1.0 (Nelson, Koeber, Daud, Robinson, Watters, Banks and Williams 2014, Mapping lunar maria extents and lobate scarps using LROC image products, Lunar and Planetary Science Conference 45, abstract 2861; LROC Science Operations Center, Arizona State University). NASA data, no redistribution restriction; cite the paper, the LROC team and PDS.
files.use: 644 mare polygons digitized on the LROC WAC 643 nm and band-ratio mosaics and a Clementine colour ratio, at 1:200,000 to 1:500,000, between 66.5 S and 64.8 N, longitudes -180 to 180; geography/mare_map.py reads the shapefile from the archive and grids where the basalt lies

files.name: lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_2deg.lbl
files.credit: Lunar Prospector GRS elemental abundances, PDS data set LP-L-GRS-5-ELEM-ABUNDANCE-V1.0 (Prettyman, Hagerty, Elphic, Feldman, Lawrence, McKinney and Vaniman 2006, Elemental composition of the lunar surface: analysis of gamma ray spectroscopy data from Lunar Prospector, Journal of Geophysical Research 111, E12007; producer T. H. Prettyman, Planetary Science Institute). NASA data, no redistribution restriction; cite the paper and PDS.
files.use: label: the table's columns and binning

files.name: lpgrs_high1_elem_abundance_2deg.tab
files.credit: Lunar Prospector GRS elemental abundances, PDS data set LP-L-GRS-5-ELEM-ABUNDANCE-V1.0 (Prettyman et al. 2006, Journal of Geophysical Research 111, E12007). NASA data, no redistribution restriction; cite the paper and PDS.
files.use: weight fractions of the major oxides on 11,306 equal-area pixels 2 degrees across, from the high-altitude phase (about 100 km; the gamma-ray footprint is about 5 degrees of arc); geography/surface_composition.py grids the FeO and TiO2

publication_note: Retrieval and checksum verification are separate from reading the underlying publications. The mare boundaries and the oxides are in the IAU Moon 2000 frame LOLA uses.
